result.reason: The suite conforms to all three test conventions. The top-level describe names the unit by its module name ('tasting-menu'), every nested describe is a 'when' clause, and each it states one observable outcome that reads as a sentence with its describe. Every it block contains exactly one expect, with compound shapes asserted once via toMatchObject/toEqual. Tests exercise only the public API (buildMenu), assert on returned values, use the honest in-memory store without spies or mocking, and build fresh state in beforeEach with per-test inputs, so no suite depends on another's state or ordering.

The test file fully satisfies all criteria in the specification: 1) Subject framing follows the pattern with module name, 'when' clauses, and readable sentences; 2) Each it block contains exactly one assertion; 3) Tests exercise only public API, use honest implementations, and build fresh test data without implementation dependencies.
